summary: OpenRouter for Startups grants approved pre-Series B AI-native startups up to $5,000 in universal inference credits across 500+ models, plus waived processing fees (platform and BYOK) for 12 months. Marketing and FAQ state those figures; program terms say amounts and duration are at OpenRouter's discretion, with a ceiling of $5,000 and/or fee waivers up to 12 months. Most credits expire 6 months after issuance. Applications require an approved-partner referral, a public company website, a professional company-domain email, a valid OpenRouter account with under $500 lifetime spend, and no prior startup-program credits.
claim_steps: Confirm eligibility: pre-Series B, AI-native product, public website, company-domain professional email, OpenRouter account with under $500 lifetime spend, no prior startup credits, and a referral from an approved OpenRouter partner.
Submit the application on openrouter.ai/startup-program (rolling review).
If approved, credits and fee waivers are applied to the OpenRouter account tied to the applicant email.
Use credits across OpenRouter models; BYOK processing fees are also waived for 12 months if approved. Most credits expire 6 months after issuance.

social_proof.title: OpenRouter for Startups Terms & Conditions | OpenRouter
social_proof.text: If approved, Participants may receive promotional credits and/or waived or discounted platform fees. OpenRouter determines the availability, amounts, and duration of any Program benefits in its discretion. Program benefits may include credits in an amount up to $5,000 USD and/or waived platform fees for a period of up to twelve (12) months.
